title: Workspace Brand Asset create and import lifecycle

phases.objective: Allow an authenticated workspace owner/admin or explicitly delegated Brand manager to persist or idempotently import one Brand Asset through the existing workspace_assets authority, with exact tenant-brand/Brand Workspace validation, bounded provenance and checksum evidence, same-transaction readback, and generated operation governance.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated workspace owner/admin or user with explicit active brand admin/manage/edit grant
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /me/workspaces/{tenant_id}/assets with asset_type, asset_ref, brand_ref, source_type and optional checksum/provenance fields
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The request resolves one active tenant Brand and Brand Workspace, proves mutation authority without workspace-wide leakage, creates or idempotently reuses one workspace_assets row, persists bounded provenance/content identity, verifies exact Brand and provenance readback before commit, and is classified as a tested transactional state change by generated frontend operation governance.
steps: Validate asset type, durable asset_ref, required Brand reference, initial lifecycle state, bounded source type, and optional SHA-256 checksum before database access.
Revalidate exactly one active actor membership with a locking read inside the transaction.
Resolve exactly one active tenant_brand_links + brands authority row without cross-tenant fallback.
Resolve exactly one workspace_registry Brand Workspace with linked_brand_key equal to the canonical Brand target key.
Authorize workspace owner/admin directly or require an explicit unexpired brand-scoped admin/manage/edit workspace_resource_grants row for delegated mutation.
Validate any vault_id against the same tenant and active vault state.
Lock the durable (tenant_id, asset_type, asset_ref) identity and reject deleted, cross-Brand, checksum-conflicting, or provenance-conflicting reuse.
Insert a new workspace_assets row or boundedly backfill missing compatible provenance while preserving canonical brand_ref.

Persist workspace-asset-provenance-v1 metadata including source type/provider/URI/revision, checksum when supplied, deterministic content identity, ingestion mode, actor, tenant and Brand target key, with secrets_included=false.
Read back exactly one persisted asset under lock before commit and verify Brand plus requested provenance/checksum.
Register exact frontend operation evidence for POST /me/workspaces/{tenant_id}/assets and generate a state_change rule only when all required evidence passes.
Require generated operation governance, frontend dispatch and runtime route evidence to match the final source tree.
assertions: Plain workspace membership without owner/admin role or explicit Brand admin/manage/edit grant cannot create or import a Brand Asset.
A Brand missing from the tenant fails before any workspace_assets identity query, preventing cross-tenant existence leakage.
Canonical persisted brand_ref is the resolved Brand target_key, not an arbitrary caller string.
Same tenant/type/ref with the same Brand and compatible provenance is idempotently reused.
The same tenant/type/ref cannot be silently rebound to another Brand or a different checksum/source provenance.
A deleted asset identity is not silently reactivated.
Invalid checksum/source inputs fail before database authority resolution.
The persisted response exposes only a bounded provenance projection and declares secrets_included=false.
The operation-governance generator fails closed when Brand Asset authority, conflict, readback or registered test evidence is removed.
With complete evidence, Brand Asset Create is classified state_change with runtime authorization, transactional readback before commit and transaction rollback.
No new asset table or Migration Apply is required; the existing workspace_assets schema remains the durable store.
No live SQL mutation, Production/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push or external send occurs in CI.
